summary: Alembic P0 CG-E consumer-side contract completed. Added a P2-consumable pure helper that requires explicit module-id alignment evidence before emitting per-module Panorama recipe counts. With accepted Core P0 directAligned=false evidence, buildPanoramaModuleRecipeCountContract now degrades Panorama recipe count display to project-total-only, sets per-module recipeCount to null, and marks recipeCountSource=degraded-project-total instead of raw-id joining or file-count distributing. The same helper filters modules and coverage cells to declared ProjectScope member roots so controlRoot aggregation excludes non-member roots such as BiliDili. No /panorama endpoints, provider contracts, Dashboard code, Core code, BiliDili files, snapshot tables, rescan incremental chain, branch, push, tag, or release were touched.
